items.title: Enterprise Solutions Engineer - Canada
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Solutions Engineer, you'll work as part of a driven team to unlock the full potential of our voice AI platform for a growing customer base. Your mission is to efficiently scale our technical solutions to many enterprise customers, both directly and by improving our internal processes and supporting our sales teams. As a Solutions Engineer, you can expect to: - Collaborate strategically with Account Executives to enhance the technical aspects of the sales process. - Work directly with technical contacts from our customers and prospective customers to provide bespoke support and architect solutions. - Craft compelling technical demonstrations that clearly communicate our product's value proposition. - Create technical enablement resources that amplify our sales team's effectiveness and technical fluency. - Build self-service tools and documentation that empower customers to implement solutions independently. - Identify opportunities to productize common integration patterns or features, and work with our product teams to make these real! REQUIREMENTS We're looking for exceptional individuals who excel at working with customers on technical problems and excited to work with us to scale this efficiently. You'll thrive with us if you: - Are passionate about AI, technology and ElevenLabs products. - Enjoy working directly with customers, iterating on solutions and providing tailored support - Have a talent for identifying patterns that can be standardized and scaled. - Have strong empathy for customers, sales and product teams. - Have a strong technical background in order to help customers architect integration between our solutions and their existing solutions - Experience working with customers. It’s ok if you only worked with customers in student clubs or side projects, as long as you are interested in working closely with them on a technical capacity - Proficiency in Python, inclusive of a deep understanding of software development, software architecture, and common integration patterns. - Excellent communication skills with the ability to adapt messaging to different audiences. LOCATION This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Canada, however there is a preference for candidates to be based out of Toronto. Expect regular travel for customer onsites. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.title: Compliance Advisory Lead
items.location_text: Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Washington, DC
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Robinhood Money team is responsible for building and scaling banking products that help customers safely store, move, and manage their money. The team partners closely with product, engineering, legal, operations, and external bank partners to deliver compliant, reliable, and customer-first financial solutions. As Money Compliance Lead, you will play a critical role in ensuring that Robinhood embeds regulatory compliance for its expanding suite of banking products, as well as future products. You will participate in multiple compliance functions to support the administration of our compliance management system. In this role, you will analyze regulatory changes, review marketing and customer disclosures, and provide clear compliance guidance to product teams. You will also collaborate with bank sponsors and partner teams to manage regulatory requests and examinations. Your efforts will directly safeguard our platform and enhance our customer experience. This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA; New York City, NY; Washington DC office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Partner closely with product and engineering teams to support the design, launch, and iteration of new banking products, features, and process changes to ensure adherence to applicable banking and consumer protection regulations. Perform compliance risk assessments of relevant regulations, such as UDAAP, Reg E, Reg DD, etc. Review marketing materials, customer communications, and disclosures for regulatory compliance. Coordinate due diligence requests and ongoing compliance activities with sponsor banks and other third-party partners. Own, maintain, and continuously improve banking compliance policies, procedures, and controls to align with internal standards as well as external regulatory and partner expectations Lead regulatory, partner, and internal audits related to banking products, including preparation, response coordination, and remediation tracking. What You'll Bring 7+ years of experience in financial services compliance, with deep experience in banking and fintech environments. Hands-on experience working with bank partners and engaging with state and federal regulatory agencies. Strong knowledge of applicable banking and consumer protection regulatory frameworks, including Unfair, Deceptive, or Abusive Acts or Practices (UDAAP), the Electronic Fund Transfer Act (EFTA), the Truth in Savings Act (TISA), and money transmission laws. Demonstrated ability to design and scale compliance programs for consumer financial products in a high-growth, technology-driven environment. Ability to navigate ambiguity, apply sound judgment, and communicate clearly on complex regulatory and product issues. Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet key regulatory deadlines. items.title: Staff Software Engineer, AI Security
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The mission of our team is to build a scalable and secure AI platform that enables security teams across Robinhood to develop and operate AI-powered agents and security solutions with confidence. As a Staff Software Engineer on the AI Security team, you’ll help lead and build the foundational platform, infrastructure, and security primitives that make it easier for teams to develop AI-powered security capabilities at scale. You’ll work on complex engineering problems at the intersection of AI, distributed systems, and security, with a particular focus on areas such as identity, authentication, authorization, encryption, and platform safety. You’ll partner closely with security and engineering teams across Robinhood to create systems that make AI development easier while ensuring security is built into the platform from the start. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys building platforms, solving complex technical problems, and helping shape how AI is securely adopted across security. This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA and Bellevue, WA office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Design and build a scalable AI platform that enables security teams to develop, deploy, and operate AI-powered agents and security capabilities Build foundational platform services, APIs, libraries, and SDKs that make it easier for teams to integrate AI into security workflows Design secure systems with strong identity, authentication, authorization, encryption, and data protection controls Build and operate reliable, large-scale distributed systems that support AI-powered security use cases Develop platform capabilities and guardrails that enable teams to safely build and operate AI agents Partner with security, infrastructure, and engineering teams to understand their needs and translate them into reusable platform capabilities Identify opportunities to improve platform performance, developer experience, reliability, and security through automation Help shape the technical direction and architecture of Robinhood’s AI Security platform as the team and platform continue to grow What you bring 8+ years of software development experience 6+ years of experience building large-scale distributed systems, with experience designing systems around security concepts such as authentication, authorization, identity, or encryption Experience building AI platforms, AI infrastructure, or production systems that support AI-powered applications or agents Proficiency in Go or Python, with strong problem-solving and production debugging skills Experience with cloud-native platforms and distributed systems technologies such as AWS, Kubernetes, gRPC, or Kafka Strong understanding of security fundamentals and experience incorporating security into the design of production systems Experience designing and building reusable platform capabilities, APIs, libraries, or developer tooling Proven experience delivering large engineering projects with meaningful, long-term impact Strong technical judgment and the ability to make thoughtful trade-offs across security, reliability, scalability, and developer experience Ability to solve complex engineering problems and collaborate effectively across security and engineering teams What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds. Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! items.title: Designer
items.location_text: New York, New York, United States
items.description: By bringing together next-gen technology and the finest live data available, Genius Sports is enabling a new era of sports for fans worldwide, delivering experiences that are more immersive, interactive and personalized than ever before. Learn more at geniussports.com. The Role: Designer As a Designer within our DCO team (Dynamic Creative Optimization), you will play a key role in shaping and evolving programmatic and social campaign creative on behalf of our ad-creative customers. This role requires exceptional art direction skills and a strong command of design industry standard software. Particularly in shaping existing and supplied campaigns into multiple touchpoints. You’ll develop briefs into strategic solutions that capture attention, understand how to evolve creative executions for a diverse set of placements and formats, be able to think social-first and have the ability to generate new concepts and campaigns when required. With a strong understanding of commercial advertising and branding you will confidently present ideas and solutions to key stakeholders, pushing the bar for art direction and design systems in the DCO team’s process. As part of our DCO team, you’ll also be positioned within Genius Sports Creative, our internal agency, meaning you may also have exposure to briefs from our Brand, Marketing and Broadcast creative teams. Key Responsibilities Act as a champion and guardian of clients’ brand identities, ensuring consistency and creative excellence. Develop high-level creative concepts with minimal oversight, bringing fresh, unexpected ideas to the table. Lead the development of concept-driven campaigns and scalable design systems. Define forward-thinking art direction solutions that guide image-making, and content ecosystems across multiple platforms. Translate strategic narratives into distinctive, ownable visual executions that flex across diverse digital placements. Establish clear visual territories through mood systems, reference frameworks, compositional principles, and narrative guidelines. Collaborate across disciplines including strategy, copywriting, motion, and technology to build complete performance based campaigns. Balance multiple projects and clients, delivering compelling creative solutions on tight deadlines. Produce inspiring and provocative work that connects and engages audiences. Leverage AI-powered content creation tools to concept, visualize, and prototype design solutions. What You Bring A portfolio that demonstrates concept-driven performance campaign creative, strong art direction thinking, and the ability to build cohesive visual systems that scale across touchpoints. Preferred Qualifications 3 years of experience in an agency, in-house design studio, or related creative field. Deep understanding of the creative process—beyond just campaign execution and production design. Ability to work independently while contributing meaningfully to a collaborative team environment. Strong design sensibility, with an ability to craft visually stunning and strategically sound work. Expert proficiency in industry standard software such as Figma, Illustrator, and Photoshop. Proven experience developing campaign-level creative. Strong command of photographic language, visual storytelling, and contemporary content aesthetics. Demonstrated proficiency with AI-powered content, prompting and image generation. Outstanding organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to work seamlessly with traffic/project managers, account managers, and developers. Experience in motion design or 3D is a plus. The salary for this role is based on an annualized salary range of $70,000 - $80,000. This role will also be eligible to take part in Genius Sports Group's benefits plan. We enjoy an ‘office-first’ culture and maximize opportunities to collaborate, connect and learn together. Our hybrid working models differ depending on your role and location. As well as a competitive salary and range of benefits, we’re committed to supporting employee wellbeing and helping you grow your skills, experience and career. Learn more about how rewarding life at Genius ca n be at Reward | Genius Sports. One team, being brave, driving change We strive to create an inclusive working environment, where everyone feels a sense of belonging and the ability to make a difference. Learn more about our values and culture at Culture | Genius Sports. Let us know when you apply if you need any assistance during the recruiting process due to a disability.
